description: Relaxations this content type declares against the strict base processes. Every entry needs a reason: the file is the record of what was waived and why. Steps marked relaxable="false" in the BPMN cannot be listed here — the base is strict about those precisely so a package cannot opt out.

relaxations.reason: A paper folio has no clinical SME lane. Scientific judgement on a proposed change is the agent-review branch plus the author's own reading at the findings gate, which is not waived.
relaxations.scope: All block kinds. The escalation exists for guideline content, where a clinical error has a patient at the end of it.
